Cinnabar Island Pokémon Gym
Leader: Blaine. Winning trainers: {rival}, {player}.
Hey! If it isn't {player}! Fancy meeting you way out here.
You beat Blaine? Then you've earned a break. I'm off to One Island, out past the sea, to help a friend of mine called Celio.
He's a whiz with machines, and he's building something to link PCs between the islands. How about coming along?
Will you come to One Island with me?
Great! My pal's ferry should be pulling in any minute.
No? Well, I'll wait for you in the Pokémon Center. Come and find me when you're ready to sail.
